description: Flexibility Bids is a dataset listed in SP Energy Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity network operator, published or maintained by SP Energy Networks. The " Flexibility Bids " data table includes all bids received through the Electron Platform. It provides information on the current market liquidity of DSO Flexibility and average bid prices. This dataset complies with Ofgem Licence Condition C31E. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Flexibility. Its keywords are SPM, SPD, Capacity. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.en). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-spen-open-data-portal.
